notes: Pilot pilot-bbu2-v4 (BH/RS seeds 0-9, 60k steps). NEP89 GM = inverse spinel (Al on the tetrahedral 8a sites, Mg + Al ordered on the octahedral 16d sites; Al(tet)-O 1.79 A, octahedral M-O up to 2.04 A, all O 4-coordinated, V 9.30 A^3/atom, d_min ratio 0.96), identical to the relaxed inverse-spinel reference (all 6 inverse orderings of the 14-atom cell are equivalent); hits agree within 5.4 meV. NEP89 caveat: normal spinel (exp. ground state; relaxes correctly, Mg-O 1.95, Al-O 1.93 A, V 9.58 vs exp. 9.43 A^3/atom) is +62 meV/atom (+0.87 eV/cell) above the inverse spinel and +49 meV/atom above MgO + Al2O3 (itself +13 meV/atom above the inverse spinel): NEP89 grossly underestimates the tetrahedral-site preference of Mg / octahedral preference of Al (experimentally MgAl2O4 is essentially normal). Wrong but physical ordering. Traps: other cation arrangements with 5-coordinated cations or 3-coordinated O at +0.13 eV/cell (4/10 BH runs, 1 RS) and +0.30 eV/cell (1 RS).
